latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the replication-strategy-selector skill.

- Helps select and configure replication topology (single-leader, multi-leader, leaderless), including sync/async mode, quorum settings, and consistency guarantees.
- Assists in choosing conflict resolution strategies and replication log formats for new or existing distributed systems.
- Provides guidance specific to Cassandra, Riak, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, CouchDB, and more.
- Advises when to use related skills for failure analysis, consistency model selection, or partitioning strategy.
- Designed for intermediate-to-advanced engineers and architects working on distributed systems replication.
